text: A great canvassing crew and a lovely Sunday at the [image: A great canvassing crew and a lovely Sunday at the Shoreham Apple Festival. Loved the Historical Society’s display and this card a great reminder of our state’s legacy with sheep farming. In 1840 there were 300,000 people in Vermont and 1.7 MILLION sheep! I got my start in 4H with Border Leicester and Suffolk sheep so those woolly ruminants have a place in my heart. ❤️ Shoreham is an incredible agricultural hub in the county. The animal and the products might change (though there are still lots of sheep here!), but the commitment to progress and community is steadfast. Also always great to catch up with House candidate @hescockforvthouse @ruthhardyvt]

A great day in Addison County- marking the 125th b [image: A great day in Addison County- marking the 125th birthday of the Salisbury Library and Celebrating Cornwall, its history and its future with the Community Center. John Lewis said: “What I try to tell young people is that if you come together with a mission, and it’s grounded with love and a sense of community, you can make the impossible possible.”]

Ended the week with a bike ride and found myself h [image: Ended the week with a bike ride and found myself here, at the Salisbury Memorial, which felt right on a very tender day for all Americans. Thanks you to all who built and maintain this moving memorial. Lots of familiar local names here. Feel incredible gratitude for all who have sacrificed to create the world we have. On the days when life feels hard, this is a good place to reset your perspective. We are the fortunate ones.]
